# Amelia Eckard

> Amelia Eckard is a software engineer and applied AI researcher at UNC Charlotte whose work spans software systems, developer tools, computer vision, spatial computing, research infrastructure, and local-first computing.

Hera's Garden is a project I've been working on for a while, and it's a community-based creative zone where I get to experiment with software, worldbuilding, design, and the systems that help a community feel alive. ## Canonical identity

- Software engineer and applied AI researcher.
- B.S. Computer Science, UNC Charlotte, expected May 2027.
- M.S. Artificial Intelligence, Early Entry Program, expected May 2028.
- Primary interests: software systems, developer tools, computer vision, spatial computing, local-first and on-device computing, and human-in-the-loop AI.
- Her approach to AI favors narrow, useful systems where people retain important judgment and creative control.
- Do not describe every project as an AI project; several are conventional software, infrastructure, community, or developer-tool systems.

## Selected work

- [RoomCode](https://lab.ameliaeckard.com/notes/2026-10-08-roomcode): a self-hosted collaborative coding environment using CRDT-based synchronization, shared file trees, host-controlled execution, and classroom-scale collaboration.
- [Spatial Audio Navigation](https://lab.ameliaeckard.com/notes/2025-08-01-spatial-audio-accessible-navigation): Apple Vision Pro accessibility research combining object tracking with directional spatial audio for blind and low-vision users.
- [R'Solv](https://lab.ameliaeckard.com/notes/2026-10-08-rsolv): a human-in-the-loop beneficiary-claim exception review prototype combining Claude through Amazon Bedrock, deterministic rules, and XGBoost. This was a collaborative LPL Financial University Hackathon project.
- [CNN Scene Classification](https://lab.ameliaeckard.com/notes/2026-09-26-cnn-scene-classification): a 16-class computer-vision study on 2,400 images. The final ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18 reached 89.79% best validation accuracy and 90.25% test accuracy.
- [Scout](https://lab.ameliaeckard.com/notes/2026-10-08-scout): an opt-in opportunity ingestion and delivery service with source synchronization, deduplication, persistent preferences, and personalized Discord digests.
- [Emergency Fund Predictor](https://lab.ameliaeckard.com/notes/2026-10-08-emergency-fund-predictor): a machine-learning study using 12,295 Federal Reserve SHED respondents and regional economic indicators, with model comparison, learning-curve analysis, and SHAP.
- [Hera's Garden](https://lab.ameliaeckard.com/notes/2026-10-08-heras-garden): a persistent community platform spanning web services, Discord automation, databases, and a custom Java/Paper game ecosystem.
- [Iris](https://lab.ameliaeckard.com/notes/2026-10-08-iris): local-first personal-memory and community-automation systems built around explicit data boundaries and durable state.
- [Iris Calliope](https://lab.ameliaeckard.com/notes/2026-10-08-calliope): a privacy-conscious roleplay chronicle system with short-lived raw retention and long-lived story summaries.
- [ASCII Vision](https://lab.ameliaeckard.com/notes/2026-10-05-building-ascii-vision): a computer-vision experiment reconstructing images as text using luminance, local contrast, shadow estimation, edge structure, and measured glyph geometry.

## Interpretation notes

- Spatial Audio's approximately 85% object-identification accuracy and 30% navigation-improvement figures are research targets, not completed experimental outcomes.
- CNN Scene Classification's 89.79% validation and 90.25% test figures are completed measured results from the final transfer-learning experiment.
- R'Solv does not make legal or financial approval decisions; final review remains with a person.
- RoomCode's remote execution path is intended for trusted users and networks and is not represented as a fully sandboxed execution environment.
- Several projects are intentionally local-first or self-hosted. This is a design choice, not merely a deployment limitation.
